    CHAPTER 2

    GOON CAVE

    Descend into the darkness. Survive the horrors. Find the four.

    Detective Yuto's intel was right. Beneath the old quarry outside Lake City, Bakura and Scarlet went down into the Goon Cave — and sealed it behind them.

    Whatever ritual Bakura began down there changed the cave itself — walls shifting, creatures forming from the darkness, reality bending deeper the further you go.

    Four floors. Four of them waiting at the bottom. Find the four… and end it.

    THE NIGHTMARE ENDS... FOR NOW

    With Bakura's defeat, the Goon Cave's spell began to shatter. Shadow Detective Services breached the depths at dawn.

    Querbito was never real — a manifestation of the cave itself, born from Bakura's ritual. When the ritual broke, it dissolved into the dark.

    Scarlet and Abudy were found alive, both bound under Bakura's spell. After questioning, Scarlet was found innocent — she had fought the ritual from the inside. Abudy is recovering under SDS protection.

    But Bakura vanished.

    His body was never found. Somewhere above, his cult is already regrouping... and two of SDS's own are about to go missing.
